feature: Source-backed monster melee choice and target-policy audit
status: Exact melee choice helper and test fixture corrected; no live Session special-skill integration claim

observations: At 226s a green enemy is visible in the corridor. At 228s the combat tutorial starts; at 230-232s the tutorial says red circles appear under enemies within attack range; at 234-236s it instructs the player to tap the attack icon. At 238-240s it says the player continues attacking until the target moves out of range or is destroyed.

The frames show generic Act 1 enemy approach/attack guidance, but do not identify the visible enemy as Swamp_LizadMan_Type1 or expose its SkillTree property. The model-specific SkillTree fact comes from the original tables and exact script scalar, not visual attribution.

sourceBehavior: monster_OnEnemySpotted checks HasTarget; if false, it calls SetTarget(enemy), then HeadTo(enemy). The existing target remains authoritative; the script does not replace it.

monster_OnTargetInMeleeRange calls Stop first. If the captured SkillTree value is greater than -1, it calls GetRand(0,100); a strict result below 40 calls DoSkill(0). Otherwise it calls Attack(GetTarget()).

SkillTree is assigned from one Lua expression, FromFixed(GetProp(GetPyStruct('CharacterProperties','SkillTree'))). The actual FromFixed callback returns two Lua results; single assignment preserves result zero, the source signed arithmetic-shift result. The prior raw/256 test approximation selected the wrong return for negative raw values.

CharAI::_UpdateAggro at 0x3cf3f0 is called from the frame dispatcher at 0x3cfcf4. The recovered body gates player/faerie/NPC classifications, MyTurn and delay state; it uses App.GetDt and, unless DisableAIDelayTimerOptim is set, Random(0,200)+100 when a stored delay expires. Ordinary selection uses original view/no-aggro/spawn radii and source list60 Search with flags 0x80000001; tracked monster aggro additionally uses list70 Search with flags 1 and threat/relation providers.

CharAI::_UpdateTarget at 0x3cb908 calls target IsInteractive and IsDead, performs sight updates, then uses the authored melee/ranged range helpers. Its sight query uses strict squared-radius comparison; qualifying range events are raised each update, not only on transitions.

actualData.melee_result: Stop then Attack(GetTarget()) for either sampled roll; no Random call is admitted because SkillTree is not greater than -1

present: The modern RuntimeEnemyController uses the same live ActorState target, original AI row, actor properties, same-world eligibility and faction checks, signed sneak gate, authored no-aggro/view radii, LOS hook, authored melee-range kernel, shared navigation, and CombatSession request_actor_attack endpoint.
The controller's stable ActorId scan is a modern deterministic candidate ordering; it does not claim source list60 ordering or source Random200/MyTurn cadence.
not_present: For SkillTree-positive rows, default RuntimeEnemyController does not borrow the same Application RNG and active AISExternal/SkillAI/VM DoSkill(0) execution path. Its optional special_action hook is not itself proof of those owners. Do not replace DoSkill with a basic attack and call it source-identical.
Native aggro threat lists, relation events, and source ClearAggro/AddAggro records remain outside the generic controller's ActorState.target_id ownership.

implementation.policy: Added choose_monster_melee_action(skill_tree_id, source_roll), used by the borrowed-actor monster event dispatcher. Corrected both native and actual-Lua test setups to call dh2_script_scalar_from_fixed and use result[0]; this preserves the exact source comparison and avoids a fabricated random draw on negative SkillTree values.
implementation.architecture: No target registry, ActorState, World, FSM, RNG, or source skill owner was copied. No root Session/main/core/CMake edits were made.

verification.actualLua: Real Lua 5.1 runtime executed the asset-backed monster.luac callbacks and compared exact callback order against the C++ event dispatcher across 1,408 fixtures. Actual Swamp lizard melee cases for rolls 39 and 40 both produced Stop, Attack and no RNG; resolved SkillTree was -1.
verification.actualTables: Same runner tested the exact source FromFixed result and event kernel across all 239 original Character rows selecting the monster script; all passed, including strict 39/40 choice boundary and the 12 rows whose SkillTree is greater than -1.
verification.integration: These are feature-owned source-bytecode/table and event-kernel tests, not a live CombatSession special-skill integration test or a visual runtime claim.

nextRootApi: To add source-identical skill selection in RuntimeEnemyController, provide a borrowed same-session Application Random(0,100) operation and the actual retained AISExternal/SkillAI/VM DoSkill(0) action endpoint with the source actor owner pinned for the synchronous call. The controller should skip the RNG branch when exact SkillTree <= -1; for Swamp_LizadMan_Type1 it already needs only the basic melee request.
